item.text: I’ll trace how subscription plans are read and changed, then update the shared enforcement paths and trial sweep so they use the same authority.

The enforcement paths already read organizations through a shared repository, but rate limiting maintains a separate in-memory plan map. I’m correcting both read paths and restricting the expiry sweep to subscriptions still marked as trials.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace('getDb, members, organizations','getDb, members, organizations, subscriptions')
s=s.replace('.select()\\n    .from(organizations)', '.select({ org: organizations, subscriptionPlan: subscriptions.plan })\\n    .from(organizations)\\n    .leftJoin(subscriptions, eq(subscriptions.orgId, organizations.id))',2)
s=s.replace('return row ? toOrganization(row) : null;', 'return row ? { ...toOrganization(row.org), plan: row.subscriptionPlan ?? row.org.plan } : null;',2)
s=s.replace('.select({ org: organizations })', '.select({ org: organizations, subscriptionPlan: subscriptions.plan })').replace('.innerJoin(organizations, eq(organizations.id, members.orgId))', '.innerJoin(organizations, eq(organizations.id, members.orgId))\\n    .leftJoin(subscriptions, eq(subscriptions.orgId, organizations.id))')
s=s.replace('return rows.map((row) => toOrganization(row.org));','return rows.map((row) => ({ ...toOrganization(row.org), plan: row.subscriptionPlan ?? row.org.plan }));')
s=s.replace('  return toOrganization(row);\\n}\\n\\nexport async function archiveOrg', '  return (await findOrgById(orgId)) ?? toOrganization(row);\\n}\\n\\nexport async function archiveOrg')
s=s.replace('  return toOrganization(row);\\n}\\n\\n/** Feeds', '  return (await findOrgById(orgId)) ?? toOrganization(row);\\n}\\n\\n/** Feeds')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts'; s=open(p).read().replace('and, isNotNull, lte, ne','and, eq, isNotNull, lte, ne'); s=s.replace('        ne(subscriptions.plan, \"free\"),','        ne(subscriptions.plan, \"free\"),\\n        eq(subscriptions.status, \"trialing\"),'); s=s.replace(' * Every paid subscription starts life as a trial whose first period is the\\n * trial window, so \"a paid plan whose period has run out\" is the whole test.',' * Only subscriptions still in their trial period are eligible.'); open(p,'w').write(s)
PY"
